Parameters (inout) currentDataLength This parameter contains the length in bytes of the dataInOut array. It include fixed length and variable length data. Parameters (out) ErrorCode If the operation Xxx_RequestResults returns value E_NOT_OK, the Dcm module shall send a negative response with N Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Request was successful. E_NOT_OK: Request was not successful. DCM_E_PENDING: Request is not yet finished.
